primary_reference.observations: Source text describes vertical unbranched cylindrical endichnial burrows, protruding above bed tops, diameters 4.6–9.9mm and typically massive filling; walls thin and may have corrugations. Actual photographs show bed-top ends, not full-depth sections. The explicit absence of cross-sectional views prevents confident ichnospecies identification. Therefore this candidate is a genus-level stylized conceptual cutaway, not a measured specimen reconstruction or demonstrated cross-section of those fossils. No universal habitat or tracemaker is asserted.

concept.observations: Concept provides a display idea only. Its inconsistent disconnected shaft ends are not accepted as fossil evidence and were not copied: final geometry uses seven continuous independent columns. No new concept was generated.

frames.observations: Three clear full-height straight cylinders remain in a stepped front cutaway, with four rear round filled sections visible on top. Quiet solid sandstone, no reconstructed animal, roots, funnel, branch or loop. No visible coplanar flashing or overlapping top paint.
Intact back and side are intentionally quiet. Seven protruding filled circular tops are legible with the front cutaway on the far edge. No seam overlay or malformed sixth top is visible.
Three parallel independent full-height shafts and stepped shoulders remain legible. Dark faces are lighting/shading on volumetric shafts, not a painted or transparent plane.
Intact plain host side and slightly protruding top endpoints. No new side bulge or exposed floating component. Side need not expose shafts because the frozen display is a front cutaway.
Quiet intact back surface with slight top protrusions. No added regular ribbing, texture or extraneous reconstruction.

Seven spatially separate circular/faceted filled sections, including three at stepped front boundaries and four rear positions. The small sixth section remains separate and visually consistent; no apparent merged opening.
Neutral material confirms actual front negative cutaways and full cylindrical volumes, rather than relying on color. No obvious coplanar stripes or self-intersection artifacts.
Dark diagnostic confirms solid block/cutaway silhouette and three front volumetric shafts. No thin planes or unexpected fragments.

scope: Independent static visual/factual review only. CPU stills are not GPU or composed-scene evidence.
